Definition / formula: Mean circularity = 4π × area / perimeter² across filtered low-signal objects.
Key parameters: Low mask = intensity <= low threshold; remove objects smaller than 16 px; connected components labeled with skimage.measure.label; region properties from regionprops.
Notes: Objects with zero perimeter are excluded or assigned zero according to implementation.

Definition / formula: Mean solidity of filtered low-signal objects from regionprops.
Key parameters: Low mask = intensity <= low threshold; remove objects smaller than 16 px; connected components labeled with skimage.measure.label; region properties from regionprops.
Notes: Solidity = object area / convex hull area.

Definition / formula: Mean eccentricity of filtered low-signal objects from regionprops.

Definition / formula: Mean major_axis_length / minor_axis_length across filtered low-signal objects.
Key parameters: Low mask = intensity <= low threshold; remove objects smaller than 16 px; connected components labeled with skimage.measure.label; region properties from regionprops.
